primary_task: Harden code against vulnerabilities (OWASP-style controls, threat model, dependency audit) in the working project.

requirements.name: read/edit files
requirements.evidence: "Validate all external input at the system boundary"; "Parameterize all database queries"
requirements.basis: edit: edit existing files and Jupyter notebooks

requirements.name: package manager native audit (npm audit, pnpm, pip etc.)
requirements.evidence: "Run the detected package manager's native audit against the committed lockfile before every release"
requirements.basis: bash: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget ...); npm and PyPI are open

notes: Audits query the registry advisory endpoint; npm and PyPI are open. A manager whose registry is not allow-listed would be unknown. Signature verification is optional.
